openings.claim: Unresolved row correspondence might leave quantity invariant across every evidence-supported interpretation. Replace single active-row selection with a spreadsheet/script possibility ledger retaining every row, original unit, supplied conversion, status, cutoff and explicit supersession; carry ambiguous alternatives without inferring identity from equal quantities.
openings.discriminator: Against the incumbent explicit-link ledger, which leaves missing identity unresolved: if every admissible interpretation yields the same quantity, reconcile quantity while leaving identity unresolved; otherwise report recorded alternatives and bounded disagreement. Differing evidence would be more supported resolutions without additional unsupported definite claims. Invariant batches may not exist.
openings.probe: Review both supplied copies, disturbed and undisturbed, with variant and incumbent; freeze outputs before opening the sealed key. Each review: sixty minutes, twelve cited decisions, retained duplicate/unmatched rows, at most three requests naming missing fields/records. Extra twenty minutes only compares resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and requests; audit interpretation completeness. Defeat: omitted interpretations produce false invariance, records cannot bound ambiguity, or computation prevents timely decisions. A time cap alone is uninformative.
openings.uncertainty: Only supplied conversion and dictionary authorize interpretation; undefined status stays unknown; no neighboring quantity fills missing data. Complete coverage and manageable branching are unproven. If coverage cannot be established, retain disagreement, identify unknown extent and request linkage/status evidence within three requests. Synthetic proposal; feasibility and improvement unmeasured.
